candidates.change_summary: Delete the assert statement so deposits of zero value no longer revert.
Replace the incremental balance update with an assignment that overwrites the existing balance instead of accumulating it.
Change the balance update from addition to subtraction so deposits decrease instead of increase the sender's balance.
Insert a require(msg.value > 0) check so zero-value deposits revert even when the assert is satisfied.
Move the balance update before the assert so the assert's overflow condition is evaluated against the updated balance, allowing overflow-induced failures to be skipped.
Change the require guard to strict inequality so withdrawing exactly the full balance reverts.
Delete the balance-decrement statement so the caller's recorded balance is never reduced on withdrawal.
Decrement the balance by one wei less than the withdrawn amount, leaving a residue in the recorded balance.
Delete the transfer so no ether is sent while the balance is still decremented.
Replace the balance subtraction with an addition so withdrawing increases the caller's recorded balance.
Delete the require(creator == msg.sender) check so any caller can migrate the funds.
Replace the transfer recipient `to` with `msg.sender`, sending the funds to the caller instead of the given address.
Replace the transferred amount address(this).balance with 0 so no ether is sent during migration.
Insert a balance-clearing statement before the transfer so the contract balance becomes zero and the transfer sends nothing.
